title: A supported Koszul detector relative to an open
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], with derived module categories and exact open restriction [def-pc-derived-category]. Let T be closed with quasi-compact complement, and let X=U union V with U quasi-compact open and V affine open. There is a perfect quasi-coherent A [def-pc-perfect-complex], with every cohomology stalk outside T zero, whose derived restriction to U is zero. For every quasi-coherent C supported on T whose restriction to U is zero, vanishing of Hom(A[n],C) for all integers n implies C is zero. No arbitrary perfect summand and no right adjoint is part of this statement.

source.place: Tag 0A9A: affine detection and supported Koszul construction on the affine complement

proof.text: Put S=T intersect (X minus U). It is closed in X and contained in V by the cover. Its complement in V is (U intersect V) union (V minus T), which is quasi-compact by quasi-separatedness and the two compactness assumptions. Apply the affine supported detector on the scheme V, with the singleton affine cover, to obtain B perfect, quasi-coherent, supported on S, detecting all supported objects on V.

Take its exact extension by zero along V into X. Supported open pushforward identifies it with derived direct image and makes it perfect and supported on S. The affine inclusion is quasi-compact and separated, so derived direct image preserves quasi-coherent cohomology. The support disjoint from U makes restriction to U zero.

For C supported on T and zero on U, its restriction to V has support in S: stalks off T are zero by hypothesis, and stalks on U are zero by exactness of restriction and homology. Extension-by-zero derived adjunction transfers orthogonality to A to orthogonality to B on V. The affine detector makes C restricted to V zero. The given vanishing on U and derived isomorphism detection on the cover U,V, applied to C to zero, show that C is zero globally.

theorem exists_supported_koszul_relative_detector
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTc : IsCompact Tᶜ)
    (U : X.Opens) (V : X.affineOpens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    (hcover : U ⊔ (V : X.Opens) = ⊤) :
    ∃ A : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X, Scheme.IsPerfect X A.obj ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj A.obj).val.presheaf x))) ∧
      IsZero ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
        (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj A.obj) ∧
      ∀ C : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
        (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj C.obj).val.presheaf x))) →
        IsZero ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj C.obj) →
        (∀ n : ℤ, Subsingleton (A.obj⟦n⟧ ⟶ C.obj)) → IsZero C.obj
